#!/bin/bash

# Read the CSV and convert each line to JSON for ingestion
tail -n +2 /data/samples/user_activity_sample.csv | while IFS=, read -r event_id event_ts user_id action duration_ms; do
  # Default duration to 0 if empty or null
  if [ -z "$duration_ms" ] || [ "$duration_ms" = "null" ]; then
    duration_ms=0
  fi

  echo "Loading: $event_id"

  curl -s -X POST http://localhost:4000/ingest/UserActivity \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d "{
      \"event_id\": \"$event_id\",
      \"event_ts\": \"$event_ts\",
      \"user_id\": \"$user_id\",
      \"action\": \"$action\",
      \"duration_ms\": $duration_ms
    }" && echo " ✓"
done

echo "All data loaded!"
